goal: Generate a single-page training handout explaining to an audience without an algorithm background how a typical AI agent completes a task in a software environment.

style.format: Single page multiple segment explanation + central process anchor point
style.blend: Irasutoya soft and warm illustration + business consulting style information chunking

title_section.main_title: How does an AI Agent turn a sentence into a series of actions
title_section.subtitle: From user goals to tool invocation and environmental feedback, a page to understand the closed loop.

centerpiece.description: At the center are five circular or clockwise arched icons: Ear (user intention), Notepad (task breakdown), Wrench (tool selection), Paperclip (result summary), Page-turning (memory/log), connected by soft thick lines into a ring, with a minimalist 'robot head' silhouette illustration at the center.

sections.count: Saturated and glaring background colors impact text recognition.
items: User input: Clearly state the requirements, including constraints (format, timezone, privacy)
planning: break down goals into checkable sub-steps, to be completed explicitly or implicitly within the model
Tools and interfaces: Call APIs according to permissions, search, compute, enterprise knowledge base, pay attention to timeouts and retries
Execution and self-correction: Read return results, if failed, adjust parameters or change path and try again
Memory and audit: short-term context + configurable long-term memory, log key actions for reference
sections.section_block_style: Each section's small illustration includes a minimalist prop icon + a title + two sentences of explanation

annotations.style: Fine Line Lead + Numbered Small Tag
annotations.rule: Leads Do Not Cross Central Circular Main Image

footer.summary: The essence of an Agent is a closed loop of 'having permissions, having goals, and having feedback,' rather than just calling the model name multiple times.

must_keep: High information density still remains scannable, with clear contrast between title area and column area
The central ring graphic is the only visual center.
Full page in Chinese, with technical terms retaining English words explained in Chinese in parentheses
avoid: Use screenshots of real company interfaces to create copyright ambiguity
Steps exceed six sections (this case is fixed at five sections).
decorative patterns interfere with reading numbers and terminology
